verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail (now LegalZoom Virtual Mail) is a physical mail-handling service built on its own network of 53 street addresses and on facilities the vendor operates for opening, scanning and shredding mail. Self-hosting the core product does not fit this kind of service, so the story's axis does not apply. Its API and MCP server are vendor-hosted endpoints, not self-hostable software.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
